mapper.select: SELECT sd.goods_id AS goodsId, SUM(sd.count) AS totalSales FROM sales_detail sd INNER JOIN sales s ON sd.sales_id = s.id WHERE s.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY sd.goods_id

SELECT gb.id, gb.goods_id AS goodsId, gb.batch_no AS batchNo, gb.supplier_id AS supplierId, gb.storage_id AS storageId, gb.purchase_price AS purchasePrice, gb.initial_count AS initialCount, gb.current_count AS currentCount, gb.purchase_id AS purchaseId, gb.create_time AS createTime FROM goods_batch gb WHERE gb.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND gb.current_count > 0 ORDER BY gb.storage_id, gb.create_time ASC

SELECT gb.id, gb.goods_id AS goodsId, gb.batch_no AS batchNo, gb.supplier_id AS supplierId, gb.storage_id AS storageId, gb.purchase_price AS purchasePrice, gb.initial_count AS initialCount, gb.current_count AS currentCount, gb.purchase_id AS purchaseId, gb.create_time AS createTime FROM goods_batch gb WHERE gb.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND gb.storage_id = #{storageId} AND gb.current_count > 0 ORDER BY gb.create_time ASC

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.barcode, g.retail_price AS retailPrice, g.purchase_price AS purchasePrice, g.unit, g.specs, g.count, g.reserved_count AS reservedCount, g.supplier_id AS supplierId, SUM(gb.current_count) AS batchCount FROM goods g INNER JOIN goods_batch gb ON g.id = gb.goods_id WHERE gb.storage_id = #{storageId} AND gb.current_count > 0 GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.barcode, g.retail_price, g.purchase_price, g.unit, g.specs, g.count, g.reserved_count, g.supplier_id ORDER BY g.name
